limitations: SwiftShader browser correctness only; no hardware performance or primary timing qualification.
CSS captures are semantic readiness checks. Every A/B and restore comparison uses unresized device-pixel PNGs.
The zero or near-zero host lifetime is exercised through a real 80x80 viewport followed by restoration.
Public retained SKImage snapshot isolation is covered by the separate native unit tests; these browser screenshots do not establish retained native snapshot ownership by themselves.

independent_visual_review.scope: Representative native screenshots; supplements the complete automated pixel audit.
independent_visual_review.finding: Expected complete artwork and selection feedback, crisp chrome, and no obvious unexpected clipping or missing-content regression in the inspected native captures.

provenance_limitations: The Interpreter job built its own separate package and retained its complete source/build/font manifest, but did not upload the Interpreter package ZIP. The job log proves the exact source and equivalent harness trees, explicit Interpreter publish setting and uploaded quality-artifact digest; this audit does not claim independent verification of a retained Interpreter binary archive.

The Interpreter observations do not establish AOT correctness, full SVG-scene coverage, hardware GPU performance, default-mode startup/reload behavior, or performance recovery. Those qualifications require their own actual artifacts.
